text:
Type: striped throw pillow
Use: decorating and resting on a sofa, bed or armchair; living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, coastal, contemporary
Materials: woven cotton-look fabric, fine pinstripe weave
Colors: warm grey, off-white
Shape: square, horizontal stripes of varied width, knife edges, compact
Feel: relaxed, casual, calm
Goes with: white or linen sofas, light wood, navy or neutral accents; farmhouse or coastal living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Striped Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Grey
product.description: Recycled cotton makes this pillow cozy and casual. Woven yarn-dyed stripes offer a classic feel that blends with any style room. For a different look, flip it over to the solid flax-colored side with ribbed texture. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17"L x 17"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
